local_facts.claim: Alabama follows the pure contributory-negligence rule. The Alabama Supreme Court affirmed an instruction that the “slightest bit” of contributory negligence bars recovery on a negligence claim.
local_facts.why_it_matters: In a truck claim, a small disputed statement about speed, lane position, following distance, distraction, or reaction can become central. Evidence has to be preserved and the crash sequence examined before anyone accepts a shared-fault label.
local_facts.title: In Alabama, even slight claimant fault can bar a negligence recovery

local_facts.claim: A Federal Highway Administration report on ALDOT’s I-59/20 reconstruction says the Downtown Birmingham project reached from Arkadelphia Road to east of the I-65 interchange, included I-59/20–I-65 interchange modifications, and affected approximately 250,000 vehicles per day.
local_facts.why_it_matters: On a high-volume interchange, lane position, ramp selection, traffic movement, and the sequence of vehicles can be important evidence. A crash report alone may not answer those questions, so scene evidence and carrier data should be preserved early.
local_facts.title: Birmingham’s I-20/I-59 and I-65 interchange carries heavy traffic

local_facts.claim: The Tenth Judicial Circuit states that Jefferson County has separate civil and criminal divisions. The Birmingham Division Circuit Clerk is located at the Jefferson County Courthouse, 716 Richard Arrington Jr. Blvd. N., Birmingham.
local_facts.why_it_matters: A traffic citation or criminal case is separate from a civil injury claim. Venue and filing depend on the specific parties and events, so the correct court and civil procedure have to be evaluated from the actual case facts.
local_facts.title: Jefferson County separates civil cases from criminal proceedings

anchors.label: Complaint over $50,000, Jefferson County Circuit Court
anchors.detail: The clerk's civil filing fee for one plaintiff against one defendant above fifty thousand dollars, with ten dollars for each additional defendant.
anchors.source_name: Jefferson County Circuit Court, Civil Division filing fees

anchors.label: Federal liability insurance floor for an interstate truck
anchors.detail: Seven hundred fifty thousand for nonhazardous freight, one million for oil and most hazardous materials, five million for bulk hazardous substances.

anchors.label: Percentage cap Alabama places on an injury fee
anchors.detail: Alabama's rule bars a clearly excessive fee and lists nine factors for judging one, among them whether a written agreement was signed by the client.

anchors.label: Demanding a jury in a Jefferson County civil case
anchors.detail: A separate statutory line item, charged on top of the docket fee when a party asks for a jury rather than a bench trial.
anchors.source_name: Ala. Code 12-19-71(a)(13), Jefferson County fee distribution chart

fee_rows.stage: Workers' compensation, the one capped percentage
fee_rows.note: A judge fixes the plaintiff's attorney fee in a compensation case and it cannot exceed fifteen percent of the compensation awarded or paid.

fee_rows.stage: What a contingent agreement must contain
fee_rows.note: The method of computing the fee, the percentages on settlement, trial and appeal, and the expenses deducted, plus a written accounting at the end.

fee_rows.stage: Where Alabama forbids a contingent fee
fee_rows.note: A fee turning on securing a divorce, on alimony, support or a property settlement in lieu of it, and any fee for defending a criminal case.

fee_rows.stage: Smaller claim, and getting the truck driver served
fee_rows.note: The civil docket fee up to fifty thousand dollars, and ten dollars for every document the Jefferson County Sheriff's Department serves.
fee_rows.source_name: Jefferson County Circuit Court, Civil Division filing fees

fee_rows.stage: The motion a carrier's insurer files
fee_rows.note: Judgment on the pleadings, default judgment or summary judgment each carry the same statutory motion fee in circuit court.
fee_rows.source_name: Ala. Code 12-19-71(a)(10), Jefferson County fee distribution chart

fee_rows.stage: The lawyer's claim against a judgment
fee_rows.note: On actions and judgments for money the fee lien ranks above all liens except tax liens, and it attaches only once the defendant is served.
